commands.name: search-literature
commands.summary: Search HEP papers with INSPIRE query syntax, with optional filters for document type, date range, author count and subject, plus sorting and paging

commands.name: list-citing-papers
commands.summary: List the papers that cite a given literature record (by recid)

commands.name: get-literature-facets
commands.summary: Get facet counts and aggregations for a literature query: doc types, subjects, authors, collaborations, citations-by-year, citation summary

commands.name: get-literature
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one paper: title, authors, abstract, DOIs, arXiv id, publication info, citation counts

commands.name: list-literature-authors
commands.summary: List all authors of a paper with their affiliations and INSPIRE author ids

commands.name: list-literature-references
commands.summary: List the references cited by a paper, paginated

commands.name: export-literature
commands.summary: Export one paper's citation as BibTeX, LaTeX (EU/US) or CV text

commands.name: export-literature-search
commands.summary: Bulk-export every paper matching a query as BibTeX or LaTeX ('cite all')

commands.name: search-authors
commands.summary: Search author profiles by name

commands.name: get-author
commands.summary: Get an author profile: name, positions, advisors, students, ids (BAI/ORCID). The author key for list-author-publications is '{control_number}_{name.preferred_name}'

commands.name: list-author-publications
commands.summary: List the papers attributed to an author profile

commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Search HEP job postings, filtered by rank, region and open/closed status

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get a job posting's details: description, deadline, contacts, institution

commands.name: search-conferences
commands.summary: Search conferences, upcoming or all

commands.name: get-conference
commands.summary: Get a conference's details: dates, location, contacts, description

commands.name: search-seminars
commands.summary: Search seminars (upcoming or all), including seminars by a speaker or about a paper

commands.name: get-seminar
commands.summary: Get a seminar's details: speaker, time, timezone, abstract, join URL

commands.name: search-institutions
commands.summary: Search research institutions by name

commands.name: get-institution
commands.summary: Get an institution's details: names, addresses, ROR/GRID ids, paper count

commands.name: search-experiments
commands.summary: Search experiments and accelerators

commands.name: get-experiment
commands.summary: Get an experiment's details: accelerator, collaboration, institutions, dates, description
